{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"Product","name":"Twilight Ritual","description":"

What better way to escape the hustle and bustle of a busy working week than with our Twilight Spa Day?

Arrive any time after 4 pm and change into your robe and slippers, before taking a dip in the pool.

Enjoy a 50 minute treatment or your choice of two 25 minute treatments and then relax wrapped up on our lounger before spending more time in the Spa, until your feeling completely recharged.

Once you’ve changed, head down to our restaurant anytime after 6.30 pm to enjoy the main course from our Chefs Table and a glass of Prosecco…just perfect.

Please be advised that our aqua classes run at the following times:

MONDAY – 12:15pm - 1:00pm

TUESDAY – 12:30pm - 1:15pm
